ASKPASS_DIALOG_MESSAGE:
It seems the MITMPROXY certificate is not installed.

Without this certificate, FIT Web cannot intercept HTTPS traffic and therefore cannot works.

To install it, administrator privileges are required: you will be asked for the root password (possibly more than once).
This operation is performed only the first time.
USER_IS_NOT_ADMIN_MSG:
To run FIT, {} privileges are required.

Without these privileges, FIT cannot works.
BOOSTSTRAP_ADMIN_DENIED_MESSAGE:
Privileges denied for {}.

FIT cannot run without {} privileges.
BOOSTSTRAP_CERTIFICATE_NOT_INSTALLED_MES:
MITMPROXY certificate installation failed.

FIT cannot run without this certificate.
BOOSTSTRAP_FFMPEG_PATH_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE:
It would seem that ffmpeg is not installed or is not accessible.

Without ffmpeg, FIT is not able to record the acquisition video so it cannot run.

To resolve the issue install ffmpeg {} or follow the OS-specific guidance.
BOOSTSTRAP_FFMPEG_PATH_NOT_FOUND_HELP_WI: by downloading it from ffmpeg.org and adding the folder containing ffmpeg.exe to your PATH.
BOOSTSTRAP_FFMPEG_PATH_NOT_FOUND_HELP_LI: with your distribution’s package manager (e.g., sudo apt install ffmpeg or sudo dnf install ffmpeg).
BOOSTSTRAP_UNSUPPORTED_OS_MESSAGE:
